query.description: A part of the user's message to look for. The search ignores only the case of the ASCII letters A-Z; every other character must match exactly. Omit it to take the newest messages.

limit.description: The most messages to answer, newest first. The default is 20.

scope.description: SESSION (the default) reads the messages this session received. ROLE reads those of every session the user bound to the same role as this one; it needs this session to be bound to a role.
